decision_question: Is okhp3-skill-promotion safe, portable, and sufficiently evidenced to serve as a draftable bridge from project-local skills to canonical OKHP3/skillz distribution?
acceptance_criteria: The package distinguishes runtime source, publication mirror, and canonical distribution authority.
The package refuses blind overwrite, deletion of destination-only files, unauthorized publication, and unreviewed private material.
The package has a deterministic mirror helper with reproducible regression tests.
The package separates structural or analytical evidence from live task-quality and holdout evidence.

shared_model_or_source_limits: No provider adapter was configured; role prompts were generated but no independent reviewer executed.

unresolved_items: Run evidence, outcome, and safety-portability roles with separated contexts or record the review as analytical rather than independent.

limitations: The bundled orchestrator was run in safe dry-run mode because no agent command was supplied.
A protected or external holdout remains required before any outcome or uplift claim.
follow_up: Run a provider-backed or human-separated equilibrium review before claiming independent release evidence.
